name: zerofyeoffice
description: AI-native office suite (docs, sheets, slides, pdf, markdown, html)

scripts.test: npm run test -w @zerofyeoffice/i18n && npm run test -w @zerofyeoffice/electron-utils && npm run test -w @zerofyeoffice/font-metrics && npm run test -w @zerofyeoffice/zip-gate && npm run test -w @zerofyeoffice/docx-engine && npm run test -w @zerofyeoffice/pdf2docx && npm run test -w @zerofyeoffice/html2docx && npm run test -w @zerofyeoffice/file-parse && npm run test -w @zerofyeoffice/pptx-engine && npm run test -w @zerofyeoffice/xlsx-gateway && npm run test -w @zerofyeoffice/pptx-ops && npm run test -w @zerofyeoffice/pptx-render && npm run test -w @zerofyeoffice/pipelines && npm run test -w @zerofyeoffice/ai-search && npm run test -w @zerofyeoffice/agent-core && npm run test -w @zerofyeoffice/ai-provider && npm run test -w @zerofyeoffice/project-store && npm run test -w @zerofyeoffice/cli && npm run test -w @zerofyeoffice/ui && npm run test -w @zerofyeoffice/docs && npm run test -w @zerofyeoffice/sheets && npm run test -w @zerofyeoffice/shell && npm run test -w @zerofyeoffice/slides && npm run test -w @zerofyeoffice/pdf && npm run test -w @zerofyeoffice/markdown && npm run test -w @zerofyeoffice/html
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @zerofyeoffice/i18n && npm run typecheck -w @zerofyeoffice/electron-utils && npm run typecheck -w @zerofyeoffice/font-metrics && npm run typecheck -w @zerofyeoffice/zip-gate && npm run typecheck -w @zerofyeoffice/docx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @zerofyeoffice/pdf2docx && npm run typecheck -w @zerofyeoffice/html2docx && npm run typecheck -w @zerofyeoffice/file-parse && npm run typecheck -w @zerofyeoffice/pptx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @zerofyeoffice/xlsx-gateway && npm run typecheck -w @zerofyeoffice/pptx-ops && npm run typecheck -w @zerofyeoffice/pptx-render && npm run typecheck -w @zerofyeoffice/pipelines && npm run typecheck -w @zerofyeoffice/ai-search && npm run typecheck -w @zerofyeoffice/agent-core && npm run typecheck -w @zerofyeoffice/ai-provider && npm run typecheck -w @zerofyeoffice/project-store && npm run typecheck -w @zerofyeoffice/cli && npm run typecheck -w @zerofyeoffice/ui && npm run typecheck -w @zerofyeoffice/docs && npm run typecheck -w @zerofyeoffice/sheets && npm run typecheck -w @zerofyeoffice/shell && npm run typecheck -w @zerofyeoffice/slides && npm run typecheck -w @zerofyeoffice/pdf && npm run typecheck -w @zerofyeoffice/markdown && npm run typecheck -w @zerofyeoffice/html
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n docs,sheets,slides,pdf,markdown,html,shell -c blue,green,yellow,red,cyan,white,magenta "npm run dev:renderer -w @zerofyeoffice/docs" "npm run dev:renderer -w @zerofyeoffice/sheets" "npm run dev:renderer -w @zerofyeoffice/slides" "npm run dev:renderer -w @zerofyeoffice/pdf" "npm run dev:renderer -w @zerofyeoffice/markdown" "npm run dev:renderer -w @zerofyeoffice/html" "cross-env DOCS_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5173 SHEETS_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5174 SLIDES_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5175 PDF_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5176 MARKDOWN_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5177 HTML_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5178 npm run dev -w @zerofyeoffice/shell"
scripts.build:all: npm run build -w @zerofyeoffice/docs && npm run build -w @zerofyeoffice/sheets && npm run build -w @zerofyeoffice/slides && npm run build -w @zerofyeoffice/pdf && npm run build -w @zerofyeoffice/markdown && npm run build -w @zerofyeoffice/html && npm run build -w @zerofyeoffice/cli && npm run build -w @zerofyeoffice/shell
scripts.dist:mac: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run native:build:universal -w @zerofyeoffice/sheets && npm run dist:mac -w @zerofyeoffice/shell
scripts.dist:win: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run dist:win -w @zerofyeoffice/shell
scripts.dist:linux: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run dist:linux -w @zerofyeoffice/shell
